d: The Assistant Manager is a multi-faceted role that merges business strategy, operations, creativity, and people management. Strategically, assistant managers are responsible for driving sales results by analyzing the business and providing best-in-class customer service. They are responsible for overseeing daily store operations including opening and closing routines and driving efficiency in all store processes. Assistant managers leverage their creative expertise through floorset updates, styling recommendations and product knowledge. Assistant managers are also talent leaders, driving everything from recruiting and training to engagement and development. They are expected to show up, bringing their best selves every day. With a promote from within philosophy, our Assistant managers will build upon their initial foundation and have the opportunity to grow into the future leaders of our store’s organization.
r: Supervise salesfloor & stockroom, ensuring excellent customer service & seamless operations.
Conduct staffing and scheduling operations and payroll management.
Train and develop the non-management staff.
Demonstrate product knowledge and brand awareness, while driving sales.
Analyze reporting to inform decision making.
Protect store assets & perform inventory control.
Represent the Brand and Exemplify Company Culture and Values.
Bachelors Degree OR one year of supervisory experience in a customer-facing role
Drive to achieve results and exhibit a strong work ethic
Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Team building and ability to coach others.
Balance multiple tasks while being detail-oriented.
Engage in applied learning and proactive thinking.
Ability to show up in a fast-paced and challenging environment

d: We are seeking an experienced, commercially driven, and strategic International Commercial Manager to oversee international commercial activities, manage global business relationships, negotiate commercial agreements, and drive profitable business growth across international markets.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing commercial strategies, managing international contracts, optimizing pricing structures, evaluating business opportunities, and ensuring effective execution of cross-border commercial transactions.

This role requires strong commercial acumen, international business knowledge, negotiation capabilities, financial understanding, and the ability to manage complex relationships with international clients, suppliers, and business partners.
Develop and implement international commercial strategies aligned with organizational objectives and global business growth plans.
Manage commercial relationships with international customers, suppliers, distributors, agents, and strategic business partners.
Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, payment terms, contracts, service agreements, and business partnerships.
Develop and review commercial proposals, quotations, tenders, and international business agreements.
Analyze international market conditions, competitor pricing, and commercial trends to identify business opportunities.
Develop pricing strategies, cost structures, and profitability models for international markets.
Evaluate commercial risks, contractual obligations, and financial implications of international business transactions.
Oversee the commercial aspects of international sales, procurement, and cross-border transactions.
Monitor revenue performance, gross margins, commercial KPIs, and business profitability.
Identify opportunities for cost optimization, revenue enhancement, and improved commercial performance.
Review and manage international contracts to ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms and organizational policies.
Coordinate with finance, legal, sales, procurement, logistics, and operations teams to ensure smooth commercial execution.
Support international market expansion through commercial feasibility assessments and business opportunity evaluations.
Monitor international trade regulations, payment practices, tariffs, and relevant commercial policies.
Manage contract renewals, pricing revisions, claims, and commercial disputes in coordination with relevant departments.
Prepare commercial performance reports, financial assessments, and strategic recommendations for senior management.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, International Business, Commerce, Economics, or a related field.
5–8 years of relevant experience in International Commercial Management, Commercial Operations, International Business, or Contract Management.
Strong understanding of international commercial practices and cross-border business transactions.
Proven experience in commercial negotiations, contract management, and pricing strategies.
Strong knowledge of cost analysis, revenue management, and profitability assessment.
Experience managing international clients, suppliers, and business partnerships.
Excellent financial, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong understanding of international payment terms and commercial risk management.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and ERP/CRM systems.
Ability to manage multiple commercial projects and international business priorities.
Knowledge of Incoterms, international trade practices, and export/import procedures.
Understanding of Letters of Credit (LC), documentary collections, and international payment mechanisms.
Experience in international tendering, bidding, and contract negotiations.
Familiarity with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or other ERP platforms.
Knowledge of commercial risk assessment and financial modeling.
Understanding of international trade compliance and regulatory requirements.
Experience with pricing analysis, budgeting, and commercial forecasting.
MBA or professional certification in International Business, Finance, or Commercial Management would be an advantage.
International commercial revenue and profitability growth.
Achievement of commercial targets and business objectives.
Contract negotiation effectiveness and commercial value optimization.
Gross profit margins and pricing competitiveness.
International client and business partner retention.
Commercial risk management and contract compliance.
Successful execution of international commercial agreements.
Opportunity to manage strategic international commercial activities.
Exposure to global markets and high-value business partnerships.
Professional development and career advancement opportunities.
